scope: synthetic calibrated inspection RGB to contour reconstruction to appearance fusion; no detector or depth recovery
source: blade_recon0.2 model and synth.make_textures; new PNG RGB generation
heldout: Check viewpoint at every fit time: excluded from solver manifest and texture fusion; used only for scoring after result freeze
capture_conditions: same Global unchanged; lossless PNG Inspection/Check nominal field width reduced 5m to3m, 1024x768; all other source settings equal
normal_controls: each defect same-blade adjacent region r+0.75m, same c; defined before scoring and scored wherever covered
observability_gate: projected narrow feature width at least 2 input pixels plus raw RGB defect/background absolute contrast >=12/255; ideal projection does not alone prove image visibility
score_definitions: coverage is fused valid core fraction; contrast is normalized local-background response divided by independently resampled source albedo response; boundary is mean symmetric physical point-to-boundary distance at 50% of source local contrast; these are appearance metrics, never detector precision/recall
truth_isolation: solver receives only explicit input_bundle.json healthy template, RGB, RGB-derived masks and per-frame K/T/frame/t. Ground truth states, texture, defect labels and heldout RGB live in sibling evaluation directory. Hash access audit verifies solver/fusion opened declared files only.
classification: SYNTHETIC_IDEAL_INSPECTION; distinct from actual MAPPO Blender scenes and field measurement
reason: candidate follow-up to frozen failed baseline; explicit increased iteration budget preserves objective/validity gates and paired adjacent frames
